content.text: The Car Dealership Management System is a web-based application designed to streamline the operations of a vehicle dealership. It manages inventory, customer interactions, sales transactions, and service scheduling.
The system shall allow staff to add, update, and remove vehicle listings.
Each vehicle record must include: VIN, Make, Model, Year, Trim, Color, Mileage, Price, and Status (Available, Reserved, Sold).
The system shall support uploading and displaying multiple high-resolution images per vehicle.
The system shall maintain a database of customer contact information and interaction history.
Customers shall be able to create accounts to save favorite vehicles and track service history.
The system shall provide a tool for sales representatives to generate quotes and purchase agreements.
The system shall include a financing calculator for customers to estimate monthly payments based on interest rates and loan terms.
Customers shall be able to book service appointments online by selecting a date, time, and service type (e.g., oil change, tire rotation).
The system shall manage service bay availability and technician assignments.
